note: Craft by mx kaske: one page per hand-built component recipe — /post/<name> (9 in the sitemap; e.g. /post/data-table = 'Data Table', /post/fancy-multi-select, /post/feedback-popover, /post/activity-calendar; several ship as shadcn registry components: metric-card, action-card, form-card, section, empty-state). Pages carry a live preview plus the component source. /post/server-action-experimental-hook is a hook, and /post/google-autocomplete a combobox, so not every page maps to a taxonomy element.
